reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for configuring persistent cron schedules that automatically trigger dedicated agent sessions, with web controls, HTTP routes, and model tools for task management.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中配置和管理定时任务，并按 cron 计划自动触发专用智能体会话。
summaries.en: Configure and manage cron-based tasks in DeepSeek Harness that automatically trigger dedicated agent sessions on schedule.

capabilities: Schedules recurring tasks using cron expressions
Persists task definitions in host settings
Triggers agent sessions automatically with task messages
Provides web configuration and mutation routes
Exposes model tools for creating, listing, and deleting scheduled tasks
